quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that shows where you were once connected to your mother before you were born?
quests.hint: It can be an innie or an outie.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Did you know? some belly buttons are 'innies' and some are 'outies'.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part found inside your neck, where your voice comes from?
quests.hint: Your voice comes from here.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Throat helps you swallow food and lets your voice come out!
quests.funFact: Did you know? a flap in your throat closes when you swallow so you don't choke.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that gets gently squeezed when you hug someone tight?
quests.hint: They can feel very ticklish.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Armpits are the spot right under your arms, where your arms meet your body!
quests.funFact: Did you know? lymph nodes in your armpits help fight off infections.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that helps you bite into a sandwich. It is also the one that a dentist checks to keep healthy and strong!
quests.hint: You brush these with a toothbrush!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Teeth help you bite and chew your food!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your teeth have roots that anchor deep into your jawbone.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that bends right where your foot meets your leg and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: Your socks cover these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Ankles connect your feet to your legs and help you balance!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: it has to support the force of your entire body when running.

quests.instruction: Can you touch the body part that lets your fingers bend and curl?
quests.hint: They let your fingers bend and curl.
quests.explanation: That's right! Your Knuckles are the small joints that let your fingers bend and curl!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they act as a hinge to let you close your hand into a fist.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that you cannot see without a mirror and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: Your backpack rests against this part.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Back is the part behind you that helps you stand up straight!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the back protects your spine and supports your torso.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that smiles when you feel happy. It is also the one we use to say hello to a friend!
quests.hint: You open and close this to talk and eat!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Mouth helps you eat, talk, and smile!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the roof of your mouth is called the palate.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that helps you smell sweet flowers. It is also the one that sneezes loudly when it feels tickly!
quests.hint: It sits right in the middle of your face!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Nose helps you smell and breathe in fresh air!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: mucus in your nose traps dust and germs.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that wears cozy socks and shoes. It is also the one you stomp on the ground when you feel excited!
quests.hint: You wear shoes and socks on these!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Feet help you stand, walk, and run!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the arches of your feet help you spring forward.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that sits above your eyebrows and below your hair and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: Your hair grows just above it.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Forehead is the flat part of your face above your eyebrows!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: muscles in your forehead help you express surprise or confusion.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that bends right in the middle of your leg and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: You bend these when you sit in a chair.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Knees are the bendy joints in the middle of your legs!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: it acts like a complex hinge to let you bend your leg.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that grows along the edge of your eyelids and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: They grow along the edge of your eyelids.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Eyelashes grow along your eyelids and help keep dust out of your eyes!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: they act like sensors to trigger a blink if something gets too close.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you raise up high when you feel surprised and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: You raise these when you are surprised.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Eyebrows sit above your eyes and help keep sweat and rain out of them!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: they play a huge role in how we show our emotions.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that lets you watch your favorite cartoon. It is also the one you close tight when you play hide and seek!
quests.hint: You have two, and you blink them!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Eyes help you see everything around you, like colors and shapes!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the human eye can distinguish millions of different colors.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you pat after running a fast race -- it is also the one that makes up your leg between your hip and your knee!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the top part of your legs!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Thighs are the top part of your leg, between your hip and your knee!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your thighs contain some of the largest muscles in your body.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you rest your hands on when you stand like a superhero -- it is also the one that swings side to side when you dance!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your legs connect to your body right here!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Hips are where your legs connect to your body, and help your legs swing!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your hips are the strong joints connecting your legs to your pelvis.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that helps you keep your balance when you stand on one foot. It is also the one you use to feel cool sand at the beach!
quests.hint: You have ten, and they wiggle inside your shoes!
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Your Toes help you balance and push off the ground when you walk!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your toes push off the ground to help you run faster.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the very end of your toes -- it is also the one that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each toe!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are hard and grow at your toe tips!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Toenails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each toe and protects it!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: toenails protect the sensitive tips of your toes.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you might feel moving when you talk out loud -- it is also the one that moves up and down when you chew your food!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: It moves up and down when you chew!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Jaw moves up and down to help you chew and talk!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your jaw is the strongest muscle in the human body based on weight.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part you wrap a hula hoop around when you play -- it is also the one where you buckle your belt around your trousers!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: Your belt goes around this part!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Waist is the middle part of your body, between your chest and your hips!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: your waist is the narrowest part of your torso.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that sits just above each of your eyes and covers them like tiny curtains!
quests.hint: Hint: They cover your eyes like tiny curtains.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Eyelids cover your eyes like tiny curtains and close every time you blink!
quests.funFact: Did you know? they automatically shut completely when you fall asleep.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part that gets stronger the more you run, jump, and play!
quests.hint: Hint: They get stronger when you exercise and play.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Muscles are under your skin and squeeze together to help your body move!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it takes more muscles to frown than it does to smile.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part found at the very end of your fingers -- it is also the one that forms a hard, smooth tip at the end of each finger!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are hard and grow at your fingertips!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Fingernails are the hard part that grows at the tip of each finger and protects it!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: fingernails protect the sensitive tips of your fingers.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found on the front of your lower leg, just below your knee!
quests.hint: Hint: The bone here is very close to your skin.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Shins are the front of your lower leg, where the bone sits close to your skin!
quests.funFact: Did you know? soccer players wear shin guards to protect this important bone.

quests.instruction: Find the body part you point up high to show something is great and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: Each hand has just one, and it is short and strong.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Thumbs help your hand grip things and can touch each of your other fingers!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: without your thumb, holding a pencil or throwing a ball would be very hard.

quests.instruction: Touch the body part that gets tickled if someone touches it gently -- it is also the one that forms the bottom of your foot and touches the ground first!
quests.hint: Here's a clue: They are the bottom part of your feet!
quests.explanation: Super! Your Soles are the bottom of your feet that touch the ground!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: the soles of your feet contain very thick skin.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part found right in the center of your tummy!
quests.hint: Hint: Every single person has one, right in the center of their tummy.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Belly Button is the little dot in the middle of your tummy that everybody has!
quests.funFact: Did you know? it is a completely unique mark on your stomach.

quests.instruction: Tap the body part where the air goes in and out every time you breathe!
quests.hint: Hint: There is one on each side of your nose.
quests.explanation: Great job! Your Nostrils are the two small openings in your nose that air moves through!
quests.funFact: Did you know? nostrils widen to pull in more air when you run.

quests.instruction: Find the body part that bends right where your hand meets your arm and touch it!
quests.hint: Think about this: A watch or bracelet wraps around these.
quests.explanation: Well done! Your Wrists connect your hands to your arms and let your hands turn and wave!
quests.funFact: Fun fact: it acts as a highly flexible joint between your hand and arm.
